name: Bagaraatan
isnote: PBDB places it in Tyrannosauridae, but the Wikipedia lead gives only theropod and a reassessment (Slowiak 2024) is cited, so its position is not settled.
sum: Small theropod from the Late Cretaceous of Mongolia, whose name means small beast of prey.
